## 描述

Transmission filter under part number 35330-60070. The source records the OE number and the transmission application, but the media type, micron rating and mounting form are all unpublished. What protects the valve body and clutches is catching wear debris before it circulates, and that depends on matching the exact transmission model. From a sourcing perspective, confirm whether the filter is pan-mounted or external, and ask for media and micron data on the spec sheet before ordering.
